card.name: Small words before a following noun
card.fires_on: Mostly the word "the" (also "or", "by", "division") when a specific noun is expected next, such as "of the population" or "before the division bracket". Also seen inside URL pieces like ".d" in library links.

modes.label: "the" before a noun
modes.description: The word "the" after "of" or "before" where a defined thing like a population, domain or bracket follows.
modes.example: About 6.5% of families and 9.8% of<< the>> population were below the poverty line, including

modes.label: Link pieces in web addresses
modes.description: The ".d" piece inside a library web address.
modes.example: Selected Poetry and Prose (http://digital.library.wisc.edu/1711<<.d>>l/Jonas), a modified version of

modes.label: Linking word in a list of options
modes.example: In case of overdose, contact a physician<< or>> Poison Control Center right away.

card.writes: No clear output effect beyond a weak push toward owner-like nouns and away from contrast words like "whereas".
card.plain: It fires on small connecting words such as "the" or "or" right before a noun is named.
